a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we'd most likely both die after round 1 with the reserve at 6. So I'm departing from our agreement and will take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. Sorry. I'd rather tell you now than surprise you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
